text:
meera: Heads-up: opened PR to add a migration appendix and two new SDK examples for Dedicated provisioning + autoscale policy docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6801

dan: quick skim. appendix looks useful. can you include a short preflight checklist for tenants that use fixed reservations (so they know how to test fallback behavior)?

meera: added a 3-step preflight: 1) snapshot labels, 2) create a small throttled synthetic load against reservation, 3) verify console alerting for reroutes. pasted the steps into the PR body.

kai: nice. a couple of technical asks: 1) show the new autoscale v2 schema with `stabilization_window_seconds`, 2) replace `preemption_policy: best-effort` with the new enum `allow-preempt` in YAML samples.

meera: done. sample YAML and a compact python SDK snippet included. python snippet below:

```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
policy = {
  "cooldown_seconds": 120,
  "stabilization_window_seconds": 180,
  "preemption_policy": "allow-preempt"
}
c.update_autoscale_policy("res-prod-42", policy)
```


dan: could you also add an ops-friendly curl snippet that shows how to create a routing policy to fallback to a quantized model when capacity is reached? they'd paste it into runbooks.

meera: added this curl sample to PR description:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/policies \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"reservation_id":"res-prod-42","fallback":{"model":"gptq-7b","quantized":true}}'
```

kai: small nit: the migration appendix mentions label key `owner` -> `team` but doesn't include a safe dry-run command. can you add a jq-based dry-run that prints count by label key? ops wants that before remap.

meera: added a dry-run command that prints counts and a remediation command that uses `redwood-cli reservations update` with a JSON-merge. also added a short release-note blurb about the cooldown default change and label normalization.

docs-ci-bot: deploy preview built: https://deploy-preview-6801--docs.redwood.ai (2026-03-23T14:05:03Z) :white_check_mark:

dan: LGTM from ops perspective after the dry-run addition. one last editorial request: rephrase SLA sentence to explicitly say reroutes are excluded from Dedicated SLA unless contract states otherwise. avoids ambiguity.

meera: updated SLA wording to: "If Reserved Dedicated capacity is unavailable, Redwood may route requests to compatible hosted variants. Such automatic reroutes are excluded from the Dedicated SLA unless explicitly specified in the customer agreement. Customers will receive console notifications and webhook alerts when reroutes happen."

kai: good. approved from eng. merge when CI green.

meera: merging tomorrow morning; followups tracked in the release notes and the ops runbook repo. thanks all :thumbsup:
